people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
translations.bsb: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
translations.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
translations.asv: And after a little while they that stood by came and said to Peter, Of a truth thou also art one of them; for thy speech maketh thee known.
